_note: Blips and Chitz: where the cracked gun's last charge goes. Rick's bender was here; the Focus Crystal fell back through his portal onto the prize counter; 5000 Ticket Tumble tickets buy it back (plus a soda), and the crystal powers one more portal, to Shrimp Rick's lab.

arrive.speaker: Morty
arrive.text: Blips and Chitz. At two in the morning. Who is even here at two in the morning?

goals.start: The Focus Crystal is here. Ask at the prize counter.
goals.play: Win 5000 tickets on the Ticket Tumble floor.
goals.prize: 5000 tickets! Cash them in with Gorbi.
goals.done: Step into the portal to Shrimp Rick's lab.

got.crystal: GOT: THE FOCUS CRYSTAL. GUN PART 1 OF 3.
got.soda: GOT: ARCADE SODA. IT HEALS AND MAKES YOU FAST IN A FIGHT.

tumbleHint: Arrows or WASD: run. Grab tickets. Get off a red ring before it blows.

lines.speaker: Gorbi
lines.text: Welcome to the prize counter. Try to look excited.

lines.speaker: Morty
lines.text: That glowing crystal on the top shelf. How much?

lines.speaker: Gorbi
lines.text: Five thousand tickets. I don't make the prices. I just make you sad.

choices.text: Can I pay with a sandwich?
Where did you even get it?

lines.speaker: Gorbi
lines.text: No, you can't pay in sandwich.

lines.speaker: Gorbi
lines.text: Some old guy drank eleven sodas and threw up a portal. Then that fell out of it. Lost and found goes on the prize shelf.

lines.speaker: Morty
lines.text: ...That was my grandpa.

lines.speaker: Gorbi
lines.text: Cool. Still five thousand.

lines.speaker: Gorbi
lines.text: Ticket Tumble. The big glowing floor. Catch tickets, don't catch bombs. Thrilling.

lines.speaker: Gorbi
lines.text: Five thousand tickets. The number didn't get smaller while you were gone.

lines.speaker: Gorbi
lines.text: Five thousand. Huh. Nobody's ever done that.

lines.speaker: Gorbi
lines.text: Now I have to get the ladder.

lines.speaker: Gorbi
lines.text: One Focus Crystal. Please leave.

lines.speaker: Gorbi
lines.text: Also take this soda. Your grandpa left it. It's been fizzing at me all night.

lines.speaker: Gorbi
lines.text: And this plastic ring. You had leftover tickets. It's shiny. Nobody wants it. Now you have it.

lines.speaker: Gorbi
lines.text: No refunds. Your portal is right there. Please use it.

lines.speaker: Morty
lines.text: The crystal clicked into the gun! The screen says... "SHRIMP RICK'S LAB". Of course it does.

lines.speaker: Gorbi
lines.text: Do your portal somewhere else. Like, away from my counter.

lines.speaker: Glorp
lines.text: Kid. I haven't blinked since the second quarter of last decade.

lines.speaker: Glorp
lines.text: You going for the crystal? Then listen.

lines.speaker: Glorp
lines.text: Once a round, a golden ticket drops. A thousand points. And it runs.

lines.speaker: Morty
lines.text: Tickets can run?

lines.speaker: Glorp
lines.text: In here? Everything can run. Don't chase where it is. Cut it off.

lines.speaker: Glorp
lines.text: Only the gold ones matter, kid. Do it for me. Do it for my eyes.

lines.speaker: Glorp
lines.text: Never. Come back when you're serious.

lines.speaker: Glorp
lines.text: Gold ones, kid. Cut it off. Don't chase it.

lines.speaker: Glorp
lines.text: You won? I'm not crying. I physically can't.

lines.speaker: Jerry
lines.text: Morty! I'm not lost, I'm networking. In an arcade. For aliens.

lines.speaker: Morty
lines.text: Dad? You were just in the living room. How did you even get here?

lines.speaker: Jerry
lines.text: Great question. Do aliens need lawn chairs? I'm asking for a pitch.

lines.speaker: Jerry
lines.text: Don't tell your mother about the chair. It's in a better place now.

lines.speaker: Jerry
lines.text: The claw machine won't return my calls.

lines.speaker: Ticket Tumble
lines.text: TICKET TUMBLE! Collect 5000 tickets! Tickets 100! Bombs minus 200! Your tickets stay with you between rounds! Gold tickets: a MYSTERY!

lines.speaker: Morty
lines.text: Not a mystery. Glorp told me. They run.

lines.speaker: Ticket Tumble
lines.text: BACK FOR MORE! The floor believes in you!

lines.speaker: Ticket Tumble
lines.text: HIGH SCORE! You are legally a legend.

lines.speaker: Ticket Tumble
lines.text: TIME! You have {score} tickets! I'll hold them for you! Play again to get the rest!
